content:
**The memory lane reconciles its own branches (#936, #930)**

**What**: collectLane parents a same-day append on origin/main when the local lane ref's records are all delivered by content (lane/delivery.mjs contentDelivery, fail closed); a cross-day sweep (lane/sweep.mjs) runs after today's ship, never in --dry-run, over this host's other memory/<host>-* refs with no age cutoff: delivered -> CAS-delete local ref, pending -> re-ship with no-collect, remote-only -> report, closed-unmerged -> report; mrList gains state/merged and a headBranch filter that fails closed on a full page (#930); #920 R8 reversed: PR lookup before push, a closed-unmerged newest PR is reported, never reopened.
**Why**: the local lane ref is never deleted after a squash merge, so the next same-day ship parented on the stale tip and the three-dot diff re-showed merged records (#1023, #1050); no entry point ever named a prior day's ref.
**Where**: brain/scripts/memory/lane/{delivery,collect,ship,sweep,plan}.mjs, memory/cli.mjs, day-start(-sweep).mjs, vcs/providers/{github,gitlab}.mjs, i18n.
**Learned**: repo has delete_branch_on_merge=true and allow_auto_merge=false (lite lane PRs need a human merge, contradicting ADR-0034 L2 — Tier 2 draft filed); a whole-tree delivery check would keep a scrubbed record pending forever, so only lane-added paths are compared; sweepLanes' pre-loop git calls can throw, so the CLI isolates the sweep and reports sweep.failed.
